ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central-medial portions of both lobes. These regions are bordered by a continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the leading edge, trailing edge, and base. The right lobe contains a higher density of low-intensity vertical filaments intersecting the white field compared to the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration map along the trailing boundary, exhibiting peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a concave sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, while the leading edge (partially visible) suggests a convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A dense cluster of high-intensity circular pixel groups (barnacles) is detected on the distal tip of the left lobe. Smaller, isolated high-contrast white spots are distributed across the lower-medial section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected across both lobes, primarily oriented vertically or at 45-degree angles, cutting through the high-intensity white pigment zones.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the entire visible ventral surface; visible barnacle colonization localized on the left distal tip and trailing margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'feathered' pigmentation pattern where black pixel filaments extend from the trailing edge margins into the white central fields.
